content.text:
Here is the raw content from all the design source files and the README:

---

## apple-hig.md

```
# Apple HIG

Source: https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/

## Signals

- Hierarchy first.
- Harmony across controls and surfaces.
- Consistency across contexts and devices.

## Useful patterns

- Strong first-screen clarity.
- Platform-aware controls.
- Clean spacing and understated materials.

## Apply to NUDIMMUD

- Move the shell toward a calm, layered command interface.
- Use clearer section naming and fewer ornamental labels.
- Let the layout communicate the system before the chrome does.
```

---

## atlassian.md

```
# Atlassian

Source: https://atlassian.design/design-system/

## Signals

- Modular foundations.
- Clear content standards.
- AI-aware patterns and enterprise-level structure.

## Useful patterns

- Top-level structure that is easy to learn.
- Reusable controls with clear behavior.
- Strong content discipline.

## Apply to NUDIMMUD

- Use Atlassian as the reference for a top nav and command rail.
- Clean up naming so every label reads like product UI.
- Split the OS into predictable, composable regions.
```

---

## linear.md

```
# Linear

Source: https://linear.app/

## Signals

- Product-first hierarchy.
- Fast scanning.
- Low-noise surfaces.
- AI and human workflows share the same board language.

## Useful patterns

- One strong headline.
- Tight spacing.
- Clear section scoping.
- Action surfaces that feel like work, not marketing.

## Apply to NUDIMMUD

- Use Linear as the reference for the new top command rail.
- Keep the landing page as a control surface, not a brochure.
- Make project states and task lists easier to parse at a glance.
```

---

## notion.md

```
# Notion

Sources:
- https://www.notion.notion.site/Design-system-43bdb97d5de34e4a80ed89d8712b1988
- https://www.notion.com/en-gb/help/guides/category/design

## Signals

- Flexible information architecture.
- Wiki-like structure.
- Pages that combine docs and action.

## Useful patterns

- Centralized source of truth.
- Lightweight page hierarchy.
- Comfortable dense layouts without feeling cramped.

## Apply to NUDIMMUD

- Treat the OS as a directory of systems and workspaces.
- Make the new NexusLink landing page and client research host feel native to the shell.
- Keep reference content discoverable from the top-level nav.
```

---

## primer.md

```
# Primer

Source: https://primer.style/design/ and https://primer.github.io/design/

## Signals

- Cohesive, accessible, efficient product UI.
- Strong foundations, patterns, and components.
- Documentation that doubles as a design language.

## Useful patterns

- Efficient tables, filters, and stateful components.
- Accessible defaults.
- Product UI that stays clear under load.

## Apply to NUDIMMUD

- Use Primer as a guide for the operational surfaces.
- Make the project board, discovery catalog, and inspectors feel like real tools.
- Favor obvious interaction states over decorative complexity.
```

---

## vercel-geist.md

```
# Vercel / Geist

Sources:
- https://vercel.com/design
- https://vercel.com/geist/introduction

## Signals

- Clean developer tooling aesthetic.
- Sharp tokens and consistent spacing.
- Calm, premium, readable docs and product surfaces.

## Useful patterns

- Typography-led composition.
- Minimal but expressive grids.
- Strong empty and stateful components.
- Utility surfaces that still feel polished.

## Apply to NUDIMMUD

- Use Geist-like restraint for navigation, search, and board controls.
- Prefer one accent color per context.
- Build explicit empty/error states that match the rest of the shell.
```

---

## README.md

```
# Design Radar

Curated UI references for the NUDIMMUD OS redesign.

## Sources

- [Linear](./sources/linear.md)
- [Vercel / Geist](./sources/vercel-geist.md)
- [Apple HIG](./sources/apple-hig.md)
- [Primer](./sources/primer.md)
- [Atlassian](./sources/atlassian.md)
- [Notion](./sources/notion.md)
- [getdesign.md catalog](./getdesign-md.ts)

## Imported design catalog

- 69 getdesign.md references cloned from the live VoltAgent collection.
- Structured into AI, developer tools, backend, productivity, creative, fintech, commerce, media, and automotive groups.
- Use this catalog as the external design radar for future UI upgrades.

## Current direction

- Move from left rail navigation to a top command rail.
- Reduce underscore-heavy labels in visible UI.
- Add explicit empty and error states everywhere the shell can go quiet.
- Keep the system dense, but cleaner and more readable.
```
